description: This file is the main implementation for a WebKit-based browser injected bundle, setting up JavaScript bindings, page load event handling, message handling, and integrating with the WPEFramework. It manages URL updates, request headers, and adds custom JS classes into the page context.

classes.name: PluginHost
classes.description: Manages communication, initialization, and white-listing of domains for the WPEFramework injected bundle.

methods.name: InjectInJSWorld
methods.description: Adds a class defined in C++ as a JavaScript class into a WebKit JavaScript context.

methods.name: shouldGoToBackForwardListItem
methods.description: Determines if a page navigation item should be added to the back-forward list.

methods.name: updateCurrentURL
methods.description: Updates the global current URL string from the main frame of the page.
